walkthrough: Goal: practise V大's combined lines (two to four lines in one frame, joined, crossing, branching or near one another) the way I copy single lines.

Entry: a lesson of Combined lines at level 1 from the home: three groups (joined, crossing, branched). The first time combined lines come up their instructions show by themselves: see the whole group as one shape first, its outer ends and corners and where lines meet or cross; fix those key points lightly with Sketch; then the inside, each line between its points, in sure strokes with Draw, never erasing; compare, don't guess.
Copy: I mark the group's key points with Sketch (never judged), then draw each line with Draw, a little off as a hand is.

Compare: the whole original group lies over my lines in the thick semi-transparent red, in place (where it lies in its frame), so my placement shows; the card asks how close it is (Accurate, Almost, Again; a tap is optional). One tap on Aligned: the group moves and sizes onto my lines as one shape (never turned; my sketch marks left out), so only the shape's errors show. The pen has turned blue: I correct the worst line in blue over the old one; the red goes as my pen lands. Compare again: the red comes back over the corrected copy, aligned as I chose.

Chinese: All tools, Actions, 中文: the bar reads '组合线条 1/3', How brings the 组合线条 instructions in Chinese, the compare card says 对齐 and 原位, its three results 准, 差一点, 重来. Back to the exercise's own tools.
The end: Finish on the third group shows the whole sheet; the card reads 组合线条, 3 题 and the time, a dot for each exercise, the skill's dots, 再来一课 and 今天到这儿.
Not here: numbers for lines (the overlay is the feedback); combined lines of my own choosing; a warm-up (a unit's full lesson has one).
